what: Intro text written in two languages — when a hand enters one line in the group, all lines advance 12 times every 28ms (about .34s), from the front by the progress amount with letters of the other language (data-alt), the rest with A–Z·#%+= Text changes into scrambled letters as it translates, and when the pointer leaves the group (waits 40ms, and if it moved to another line, stays as is) it returns to the original text along the same path. On touch, a tap switches it and it returns after 1.6s

options.chars: Characters to scramble with, default ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ#%+=
options.back: Time from finger press until return (ms), default 1600
options.[data-fx-part=line]: Changing line — different text in data-alt

use:
With three small bumps
Even the last bite, made easy

from.where: index.html .k-info intro text — original .fk-rl data-alt + scr() (SCR “A–Z#%+=”, 28ms × 12 frames, per .fk-c group, leave 40ms, touch 1600ms)
